decisions.reason: As an older German wholesaler with lower sunk production costs than a manufacturer, the firm can more easily withdraw a standard perfect binder—especially if it overlaps with the stronger automatic model and later market visibility is unclear.

The fully automatic perfect binder likely reflects a more visible and strategic commitment, so management is inclined to persist and interpret any weak signals after launch as temporary rather than as a reason to exit.
The booklet maker broadens the finishing portfolio and was publicly launched, so escalation of commitment supports keeping it unless clearer evidence of failure appears.
